boundedCorrection.scope: One bounded correction of four P0 defects and one adjacent P1. No new tracing architecture, no estimator change, no context-threshold change, no compaction-policy change.
defectsCorrected: P0-1 disk bounds did not constrain actual writes
P0-2 fingerprinting ran with diagnostics disabled
P0-3 the private capture was not dogfood-only
P0-4 the exported latency trace lost the correlation fields
P1 the candidate snapshot was not immutable
boundedCorrection.nonBlocking: The invalid Leamas gate-summary binding was classified P2, NON-BLOCKING and was deliberately not spent another cycle on.

boundedCorrection02.scope: The capture-store IDENTITY and RETENTION contract ONLY. No estimator, Strata, compaction-policy, estimator-repair, Leamas gate-summary or Full-Round-C change.
p0sCorrected: P0-A the 12-candidate cap could retain 13 files because the control was capped independently of the compaction candidates
P0-B two distinct decisions with identical content collapsed onto one file, and the second write silently overwrote the first decision's snapshot
P0-C overlapping flush() calls were not serialized, so two writeFile() calls to the same file could interleave
repair: the file name is a PER-DECISION identity: <storage identity>--<content fingerprint>.json, where the storage identity is the candidate's decisionId, else preparationRequestId, else a monotonic ordinal
the storage identity is resolved in record(), so the file name is stable across every subsequent flush
the retention cap is a TOTAL over the control AND the compaction candidates; the control no longer gets a slot on top of the cap
flushes are chained on a per-store promise chain; the chain does not break on failure
an unchanged serialized payload is not rewritten, so a previously persisted snapshot is not needlessly re-exposed
boundedCorrection02.redReproducedAgainstTheProductionStore: Both reviewer counterexamples reproduced against the REPOSITORY checkout, not a source-extracted replay: I1 distinct decisions with identical content yielded 1 file (expected 2); I2 control plus 12 compaction candidates yielded 13 files against a declared maximum of 12.
boundedCorrection02.ablations: Every production change was ablated to prove its witness is load-bearing: reverting the identity fix fails I1; reverting the total cap fails both I2 witnesses; removing the flush serialization fails I4; removing the idempotent-rewrite skip fails I4b.
boundedCorrection02.green: 56 tests / 8 files PASS across the capture + observability surface (14 pre-existing capture witnesses + 6 new identity/retention witnesses). Zero regressions.
